kurz: Stand tender herbs in water like flowers, wrap woody ones in a damp cloth, and never put basil in the fridge.
bild_im_kopf: Like a bunch of flowers: in a glass of water it lasts days, without it wilts in hours.
was_passiert: Cut herbs lose water and wilt. Tender herbs draw water back up through their stems. Basil comes from warm climates: below about 10 °C its cells are damaged and the leaves turn black.
warum_wichtig: Stored properly, herbs last a week instead of two days.
faustregeln: Cut with a sharp knife: a blunt one bruises the leaves and they darken.
schritte: Parsley, coriander and dill: trim the stems, stand them in a glass of water, cover loosely with a bag, refrigerate.
Basil: the same, but at room temperature, out of the sun.
Rosemary, thyme, sage: wrap in a slightly damp cloth and refrigerate.
Wash and chop only just before use.
